sm: The Macy's Thanksgiving Day parade has been postponed until Saturday, November 28th at 8:30 a.m., because forecasts call for wind gusts of 30 to 45 miles per hour in New York, possibly exceeding the limit for flying the balloons. Separately, hackers breached the CIA, the Office of the Director of National Intelligence and the National Geospatial Intelligence Agency, reaching an open source analysis system. Officials say no classified information was exposed, and the issue has been resolved, though an AI hacking tool appears to have been involved. Huawei and three subsidiaries were convicted in New York on seven counts, including fraud, money laundering and conspiracy to steal trade secrets, and its CEO apologized to staff for affairs. Finally, the delayed detonation of degraded explosives in Iowa took place, with President Trump and the EPA saying no elevated lead was detected in the air.

Kilmar Abrego Garcia, who was dubbed the Maryland man, landed in Spain after self-deporting from the United States, and his lawyers say he will eventually go on to Mexico. The Supreme Court will hear arguments next Wednesday on whether the Second and 14th Amendments protect ownership of AR-15 style rifles, in challenges to bans in Cook County and Connecticut. A central question is whether the rifles are in common use. Former St. Louis prosecutor Kim Gardner was disbarred unanimously by the Missouri Supreme Court for misusing public funds, and Mark McCloskey welcomed the decision. The Trump administration announced new Section 301 tariffs on China, Europe and other partners after an investigation of 14 countries. The NFL also begins its Thanksgiving slate a day early, with the Rams hosting the Packers tonight.
sg: Parade Delay, Cyber Breaches, Iowa Detonation
